file_change.purpose: Provide minimal explicit non-circular acceptance, bounded authorization, lineage, stage identity, bootstrap evidence handling, and accepted-state advancement.
implementation: Define governed artifact identities and acceptance records for Design readiness, Planning acceptance, and Build acceptance.

Require acceptance records to identify subject, actor, decision, predecessor authority, required evidence references, and resulting state without deriving authority from incidental Git/platform activity.
Reject acceptance prerequisites that depend on authority created only by the candidate acceptance itself.

Preserve the minimum resolvable lineage from selected Design scope through Planning requirements, accepted Plan, Build work, required Conformance/Assurance evidence, and accepted implementation state.
Enforce keystone separation: Governance consumes Conformance and Assurance results but does not perform their judgments.
Advance accepted implementation state only on explicit Build acceptance and keep governed authorization bounded to the accepted work scope.
Resolve Core keystone delegation through explicit accepted authority relationships and apply default-deny when no accepted authority or governed extension point resolves.
Maintain stable identities for Design revisions, Planning work, accepted Plans, Build work, and accepted Build results.
Reference the minimal durable Conformance, Assurance, and Build mutation evidence needed by Core acceptance lineage.
Treat accepted functional-set/Plan schemas and modular Planning documents created before Build as governed Planning artifacts rather than FS0 Build realization.
Defer rich rejected-candidate history, generalized normative lifecycle mutation, derived/product provenance hardening, and exhaustive platform-capability policies.
